headline: Highway Signage Officials Suspended for Writing 'Exit' in 47 Different Languages to Ensure Universal Compliance
body: State transport authorities have suspended two road sign supervisors after they attempted to standardize highway exit markers by including translations in every regional dialect, including long-extinct tribal scripts and local slang for 'the big turn'. The move was intended to avoid regional language disputes, but resulted in signs so long they now extend three kilometers into the adjacent farmland.
caption: Efficiency is a state of mind, apparently. Which language are you picking for your road trip? 🚗🛣️ #HighwaySigns #Bureaucracy #RoadTrip #India #TranslationFail (satire)
igHook: Would you actually be able to find your exit if the sign was three kilometers long?
